import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:signals_flutter/signals_flutter.dart';

import '../models.dart';

class HomePage extends StatefulWidget {
  const HomePage({super.key});

  @override
  State<HomePage> createState() => _HomePageState();
}

class _HomePageState extends State<HomePage> {
  // n_todos
  final todos = signal<List<Todo>>(const []);

  // n_draft
  final draft = signal<String>('');

  // n_seq
  final seq = signal<int>(0);

  // ev_input -> a_draft
  void _onInputChanged(String value) {
    draft.value = value;
  }

  // ev_add -> a_bump -> a_append -> a_clear
  void _onAddPressed() {
    seq.value = seq.value + 1;
    todos.value = [...todos.value, _buildTodo(seq.value, draft.value)];
    draft.value = '';
  }

  // ev_toggle -> a_toggle
  void _onCheckChanged(bool? value, Todo item, int index) {
    todos.value = (List.of(todos.value)..[index] = _toggle(item));
  }

  // ev_del -> a_remove
  void _onDelPressed(int index) {
    todos.value = (List.of(todos.value)..removeAt(index));
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Todos')),
      body: SignalBuilder(
        builder: (context) => Column(
          children: [
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: TextField(
                      onChanged: _onInputChanged,
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        hintText: 'What needs doing?',
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  ElevatedButton(
                    onPressed: _onAddPressed,
                    child: const Text('Add'),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            if (todos.value.isEmpty)
              const Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.all(24),
                child: Text('Nothing here yet.'),
              ),
            Expanded(
              child: ListView(
                children: [
                  for (final (index, item) in todos.value.indexed)
                    KeyedSubtree(
                      key: ValueKey(item.id),
                      child: ListTile(
                        title: Text(_titleOf(item)),
                        leading: Checkbox(
                          value: _doneOf(item),
                          onChanged: (value) =>
                              _onCheckChanged(value, item, index),
                        ),
                        trailing: IconButton(
                          onPressed: () => _onDelPressed(index),
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// n_newTodo
Todo _buildTodo(int id, String title) =>
    Todo(id: 'todo_$id', title: title.trim());
// n_itemTitle
String _titleOf(Todo item) => item.title;
// n_itemDone
bool _doneOf(Todo item) => item.done;
// n_toggled
Todo _toggle(Todo item) => item.copyWith(done: !item.done);
